blocks.md: This lesson covers the book's section on **Spatial Belief Persistence and Expiry**. Read the excerpt, then test yourself below.

blocks.source: Vol IV, Spatial Memory, § Spatial Belief Persistence and Expiry
blocks.md: On the warehouse mobile manipulator, intermittent observation becomes a hazard at every rack corner. As the robot pivots into a turn, structural uprights occlude the cross aisle from the navigation cameras, and whatever the vision backbone detected seconds earlier survives only in memory. A worker stepping around the corner can enter the corridor that memory still records as clear. Republishing the cached perception frame with a fresh software timestamp cannot replace the missing sensory evidence.
